content: Ani Santiago, Bab-Dummad-e-mai, degi, Bab-Jesucristo-e-maibar. Israel-dulemar-sogambe-gakabo (12) we-napneggi-aisakis-bukwadga nued-sogeye sogsiid.
An-gwenadgan, bemar igar-bulegangi akar-akar-wilubdaklealile, bemar yeer-itogewilubmalad.
Bemar wismalad, be-Bab-Jesúsʼgi-bensulid-wilubdakleged, bemarga ukurmakar-ibmar-imaksulid uked.
We-ukurmakar-ibmar-imaksulid, ibmar-imaklenaid weligwaledgi obelogergebed, adi, bemar dule-innikigwadga guega, dulemar mer be-nug-oichogega, degi, bela bemar unniguar ibmar nikuegar.
Ar bemar gwenna-gwenna amba binsaed-nikagued sulile, Bab-Dummadse be egismar, ar Bab-Dummad bega ukoed. Bab-Dummad dule-gwen-obansuli bela dulemarga binsaed-nikagued ise-obinagwar uked.
Ar be bensulidgi Bab-Dummadse binsaed-nikagued egisergebed. Ar dule-bened-nikad, demar-mulluganyob gued. Demar-mullugandi unnila burwa-goledba seleddaed.
Ar dule deyob-daedi mer binsao, Bab-Dummad ega ibmar ukodeeye.
Ar a-dule, e-binsaed innikisulid, emi ibmar-soggwengi-binsaed, banegi bato ibmar-baidgi binsabalid. Geg innikii nanaed, e-daed gwage-gwage daed.
Gwenad-wis-wilesakwaa-gudiid Bab-Dummad-asabin-nug-dummarba-nikadba weligwar itogewilubbid.
Gwenad-mani-ibeddi, Bab-Dummadse nug-bipi-imaklenonikile, weligwar itogewilubmogad. Ar dule-mani-ibed dutuyob baisursunna bergudoed.
Ar dad-ibeler nakwialile, na e-dutusur-gaedba, dutu-e-gagan odingudaed. E-dutu argwatoed, e-yeerdakleged bergudoed. Debayobi dule-mani-ibed na e-ibmar-nikadi e-ibe bergudmogoed.
Dule isguedgi-wilubdaklenaidgi sikirmaksulile, Bab-Dummad we-dulegi nued binsaed. Ar wilubdaklenaidgi obichale, Bab-Dummad na e-sabmaladga dula-gudigued-ologurgin-ukoye-sogsad ega ukoed.
Ar dule-wargwen isguedgi wilubdaklear-sogele, mer sogo: “Bab-Dummad isguedgi an-wilubdaknaiye.” Ar Bab-Dummad isguedse geg wilubdakleged, deginbali, Bab-Dummad isguedgi dulemar-wilubdaksurbalid.
Ar anmar isguedgi wilubdaklealir, anmar-ibmar-isgana-imakbied, degi, galagwensuli-binsaed, isguega anmar-imaked.
We-ibmar-isgana-imakbiedgi isgued noardaed. We-isgued-imaklesad-sorba, burgwed nonisunnoed.
Gwenadgan-sabesailamalad, mer be yardaklemala.

Bela ibmar-nuegan, degi, ibmar-innikimalad, Bab-Dummadgi nibneggi danikid. Bab-Dummad-nibneggi-gwallumar-obinnisadgi danikid. We-Bab-Dummad niisgwamar-gwagdedaeyob gwagsulid, degi, burbamaryob bergusulid. Degisadegu maid.
Bab-Dummad na e-binsaedba, E-Gayaburba-Nued-napiragwad-sogedba anmarga burba-dulad uksad, adi, e-ibmar-obinnisad-abargi anmar-inse e-mimmiganga guegar.
Gwenadgan-sabesailamalad, we-ibmar an bega sogsokalid nue itomalo: Bemar ibmar-sogleged-itogega bela guakwaa gudii gumalargebed. Be-sunmakeddi, be-urweddi, na be bargamalargebed.
Ar dule-urwedi Bab-Dummad-asabin igar-innikigwad imaksulid.

A-ulale, bela igar-isgana-imaked, degi, ibmar-isgana bukidar-nikadi be mimarsun. Adi, Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-be-gwagegi-diglesad be san-bipi-itogedgi abingamalagar. Ar we-Gayaburba be-san-burba-abonogega gangued nikad.
Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-itogedginbi mer be yeer-itomar, bur eba be ibmar-imakmar. Ar degisulile, na be dukin yardakdimardo.
Ar dule unnila Bab-Dummad-Gayaburbabi-itogele, eba dasulile, dule-wargwen na isbegi wagar-dakeyob gued.
Geb na isbegi wagar-daksad-sorbali, nadele, na yog-iear naddaed ede igi-daklege.
Ar dule-wargwen ibmar-itosad iesulirdi, aka bur igar-innikigwad-dule-ollor-imakedgi nue atakele, degi, egi alamaknaile, Bab-Dummad egi nued binsaoed.
Ar dule-wargwen Bab-Dummad-igarba nue-nanadiiye binsaele, degi-inigwele, na wissur gwabin bargaele, na dukin yardakdiid. Bab-igar-wisye-sogdiid, binsa gordido.

Ar anmar-Bab-Dummad-asabin e-igar-nuedba-swilidik-nanaedi, wedo: Dule-sergan-sated bendaked, mukwamar-sui-ei-burgwismalad-wile-itodimalad bendaked, degi, san-swilidik-gudiguega we-napneggi-ibmar-isganagi bangued.
